theorem_scope: every nonsingular 2x2 integer period matrix and every periodic black-site configuration

coefficient_layers.primitive_line: canonical primitive integral representative of the rational line
coefficient_layers.saturation_index: unrestricted theorem: every connected carrier image is saturated over Z; rank-one index is one

proof_route: replace L by 2L and pass to the four-sheeted regular cover T_(2L) -> T_L
observe that every unit square has four distinct corners in T_(2L)
apply the 16-pattern 4/8 diagonal pruning before quotienting
apply the existing honest-cell complementary-subsurface theorem upstairs
descend rational graph-image ranks and symplectic orthogonality through the finite cover
for integral saturation use every honest qL cover, identify one lifted component image with H intersect qL, and choose q coprime to a hypothetical Smith defect
derive birth, reflection, reconstruction and projective primitive-line gates

regression_search.purpose: machine regression and counterexample localization, not the unrestricted proof

claim_boundary: The theorem concerns ambient H1 images of the NN and complementary matching graphs, not their graph cyclomatic numbers.
Every connected black NN or white matching carrier has saturated integral ambient-H1 image; at rank one the actual graph-image subgroup is generated by the primitive direction.
The index-2-through-13 saturation census is now regression and implementation-convention audit only.
No continuum, threshold, CFT-field or finite-size-scaling consequence is claimed.
The rational theorem uses the four-sheeted cover; the integral theorem uses the family of qL covers and a coprime-prime Smith contradiction.
